summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of DYNICTY v2.1 REPOSITIONING landing page. All backend APIs (11/11) and all frontend requirements (26/26) passed successfully. The v2.1 repositioning is fully functional with correct messaging, NO 'Coba Gratis' or Login buttons, pricing shows 'Segera Diumumkan', only Sinar Telur template available, and all CTAs correctly route to /kontak page.
